attchmntText: NMDC Steel Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: NMDC Steel Limited announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on 12th November 2026. The Board approved the Integrated financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. This approval was made in terms of SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/CFD/CFD-PoD-2/CIR/P/2024/185 dated 31st December 2024, read with BSE Circular No. 20250102-1 and NSE Circular No. NSE/CML/2025/02 dated 2nd January 2025. The Unaudited Financial Results, along with the Limited Review Report of the Statutory Auditors and other disclosures, are enclosed pursuant to Regulation 33 of SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015. The Board Meeting commenced at 18.55 hrs IST and concluded at 19.10 hrs IST. The information is available on the Company's website at https://www.nsltd.in/en.
